title: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation Announces First Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call
summary: Kaiser Aluminum Corporation (NASDAQ: KALU) today announced that it plans to release its first quarter 2026 financial and operating results on Wednesday, April 22, 2026, after the market closes. The Company will host its quarterly conference call on Thursday, April 23, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. The conference call can be directly accessed from the U.S. and Canada at (877) 423-9813 and accessed internationally at (201) 689-8573. The conference call ID number is 13759443. A live webcast and related presentation slides will be available through the Investors portion of the Company's website at https://investors.kaiseraluminum.com . An audio archive will be available on the Company’s website following the call.
